fields.description:
Following the update in ProjectCRPT-165, the Security Header now includes the ITM Number, which resulted in the ITM Key Index being reduced to 20 bits.

Given this reduction and temperature specifications (specifically PLCU-98), there is a risk that the Key Index may overflow during the systeme's operational lifetime.

To mitigate this issue, we propose the following approaches:
 # *Explicit Specification:* Formally specify that the Key Index is permitted to overflow.
 # *Key Management Optimization:* Avoid pre-generating the eight keys in advance (preventing unnecessary consumption of the index) - by changing PLCU-98.

This task is to discuss and decide the way forward.
ADDITIONAL CHECK: In addition it shall be thought of having an additional STC to generate new ITM keys. Alternatively instead of an STC it could be also by an automatism after anti-replay-counter overflow.

fields.description:
In the meeting at 11.06.2026 with ASDS there was one question regarding the need for a second physical interface to the red gateway server. See the [last point on the meeting notes|https://jira.company.com/confluence/spaces/ProjectCRPT/pages/651631751].

At 15.06.2026 we retrieved a preliminary version of the SOCs for the Issue 03 Draft GCB specification:
\\mmain.m.corp\data$\O\Project_HP\05_Crypto\20_Korrespondenz\ASDS\2026-06-15-in-draft-soc-gcu\Project-ADSF-SP-001104083_03_Draft_Ground_Crypto_Box_Specification.xlsx
In the 'Compliance Comment' column the mapping to the second GCB physical interface is marked with the sentence 'will most likely be on different physical interface'.

This ticket aims to update the GCB specification to include the following:
* A new requirement for the physical interface.
* Updated figures within the specification.
* Updated requirements reflecting the mapping of affected TCP/IP sockets (according to the SOC) to the second RSomething physical interface.

Further more based on the Krypto workshop with BSI and according to the meeting notes "\\mmain.m.corp\data$\O\Project_HP\05_Crypto\50_MeetinSomething\2026-05-12_BSI_Meeting\Project-ADSF-MN-001110544_01_MoM_Krypto_Workshop_BSI_2026-05-12.pdf"

an additional interface for the BTM/BTC on the black side is needed. 
This ticket aims to update the GCB specification to include the following:
* A new requirement for the physical interface.
* Update figures within the specification.
* Update requirements reflecting the mapping of affected TCP/IP sockets to the second physical interface for the black side.
